# Berget.AI

Use `berget/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "berget-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "berget/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8",
});
```
